The '''plasma rifle''' was a weapon used for [[Water/Legends|underwater]] environments by the [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatroopers]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] in [[137 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The plasma rifle's name was identified in concept art on artist [[Omar Francia]]'s website.
